name: 70714 · Baker, LA
findings: ZIP 70714 (Baker) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70714 (Baker) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 70714 (Baker) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
